{{Top|leg}}
A '''quella stone''' or '''quella gem''' was a small [[Color/Legends|blue]]-color low grade gem found on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]].<ref name="GNN4">{{JournalCite|4|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> They were worth between 1,500 and 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Coruscant Standard Carat]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> The thief known as [[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]] left quella stones at the scene of his crimes to taunt investigators.<ref name="GNN4" />
